messages:
Simon: Pushed a quick geo-split bench comparing mistral-7b q4_0 on A100 vs H100. Wanted eyes before I dump to the doc repo.
Maya: Nice, did you run both prefill+decode or decode-only?
Simon: Full prefill+decode @ 128-prefill / 256-decode typical chat mix. Runs were steady-state at iso-batch config (batch_size=8).
Alex: Command used?
Simon: ```bash
bench/run_infer.sh --model mistral-7b-q4_0 --hardware {a100,h100} --region {us-west,eu-west,ap-south} --prefill 128 --decode 256 --workload chat-mix --duration 10m
```
Ria: TL;DR numbers? p50/p95 prefill & decode, tokens/sec, and extrapolated $/1M tokens please.
Simon: Pasted abbreviated CSV from the run:```
model,hw,region,p50_prefill_ms,p95_prefill_ms,p50_decode_ms,p95_decode_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1M_tokens_usd
mistral-7b-q4_0,a100,us-west,45,120,5,22,4100,18.5
mistral-7b-q4_0,h100,us-west,40,105,4.6,19,4600,22.1
mistral-7b-q4_0,a100,eu-west,48,130,5.5,26,3800,19.0
mistral-7b-q4_0,h100,eu-west,41,120,4.8,22,4300,23.4
mistral-7b-q4_0,a100,ap-south,60,170,6.5,30,3000,24.7
mistral-7b-q4_0,h100,ap-south,53,150,5.8,28,3350,28.9
```
Maya: Interesting — H100 improves tokens/sec ~10-15% in us/eu, p95 decode lower by ~8-10% there. In ap-south delta narrows but cost increases a lot due to SKU and xfer.
Alex: Any kernel fallbacks or quantization caveats observed?
Simon: We saw kernel fallthrough to scalar GEMM on A100 for very short sequences on p95 in ap-south (thermal throttle + driver mismatch). PerfBot logged a few redispatches.
PerfBot: redispatch_event: count=6, affected_runs=[2923456789-01,2923456789-03], fallback_kernel=scalar_gemm, avg_penalty_ms=12
Ria: Quality check? Any regressions compared to fp16 baseline?
Simon: Ran 200 eval prompts. Quality delta (avg EM-like proxy) within 0.6% vs fp16 for q4_0 on both GPUs — no obvious regressions in the sample.
Maya: For sizing recommendations: if you care about lowest latency p95 in EU/US go H100. If unit-cost is primary and you have good batch scheduling, A100 still decent, esp. in AP where H100 SKU is expensive.
Alex: Can you add the raw perf traces to the bench dashboard and link?
Simon: Uploaded to /benchdash/mistral/q4_0/2923456789. Link: https://bench.redwood.internal/d/abc123/mistral-q4_0-geo-snap (internal).
Ria: Cool — let's schedule a short sync tomorrow to decide rollout for the default quant profile. My preference: default to a100 q4_0 for free-tier, h100 q4_0 as premium with fallback.
Simon: Agreed. I'll open PR with config suggestions and include kernel-fallback mitigations (pin driver, reduce tiny-seq scalar fallthrough).
Maya: :thumbsup: small ask — annotate which runs had NVSwitch topology vs single-socket. That was a factor in earlier run variance.
Simon: Will do, adding that tag now.
Alex: Thanks, good concise dataset.
Simon: Thanks all. Closing thread after PR.
